title: South Africa's ANC Has Its Worst Election Result Ever
summary: South Africa's governing party, the ANC, has just had its worst election result ever. Voters spoke in local elections, and even the party called it 'catastrophic.' The ANC led South Africa out of apartheid into democracy more than 30 years ago under Nelson Mandela. Since then it has won almost every election. Not this time. The party won a majority in just one province, Limpopo. In 2021 it won six. It won the most votes in only two of the eight big cities. The Democratic Alliance came second with 25% of the vote and kept control of Cape Town. Former president Jacob Zuma's MK party came third with 10% and took Durban. 'This has been a very catastrophic outcome,' said the party's secretary-general, Fikile Mbalula. He blamed the high cost of living. President Cyril Ramaphosa said the party accepts the result. 'We accept the will of the people,' he said, 'with humility.' The slide began in 2024, when the ANC lost its national majority for the first time since 1994. Now the parties have 14 days to agree on coalitions.
why_it_matters: If you have ever voted for a class leader, this story shows how grown-ups use elections to tell leaders when they are unhappy.
